about_the_game:
Lisa is ready to hop to her knightly duties in her newest costume! This allows you to change her costume from her traditional Knight gear into a sexy reverse bunny suit for use both in and outside of battle. Additionally, it changes the (non-gold) "Sealed" image from a latex vacbed to a delicious, Lisa-shaped bar of chocolate!

Once downloaded, her costume can be changed at anytime in the "Options" menu under the DLC section by selecting the "Easter Bunny" costume.

content_descriptors.notes:
Lust Knight Lisa contains explicit sexual acts that can be considered consensual, dubiously consensual, and/or non-consensual depending on the interaction and situation. The player character, Lisa, will be bound, transformed, fucked, and groped both in and out of combat by various foes and NPCs.

Additionally, losing in combat on specific nights will result in a sexually explicit scene with descriptive text and a full screen image.
